checks.name: pure identity projection contains no raw email or metadata and binds two exact markers
foreign project, real actor, preexisting UUID and incomplete plan fail before API
admin endpoint, run, artifact and exact journal prefix are mandatory
SQL commit, independent postcheck, full scope and canonical hashes are required
durable prior PRESENT identity is required even when Auth is already absent
two ordered hard deletions have durable intent before dispatch, explicit404 and no certification
a lost DELETE response performs GET reconciliation, without automatic resend
recorded intent before a crash permits only GET even if no DELETE was sent
uncertain deletion with account present stops bulk and cannot retry
null user200, GET500 and thrown404 never mean verified absence
GET failure after DELETE cannot explain revision advance and later reconciliation is read only
email, createdAt, exact marker or any metadata drift blocks DELETE
all ten POS FK effects including CASCADE and SET NULL require zero rows
unknown Auth families, changed FK catalog and incomplete counts require review
Storage owner or owner_id references, missing counts and new owner columns block
fresh PostgreSQL owner context, correct source and complete foreign protections are required
protection drift after a successful DELETE records review and preserves observed absence
disk persistence failure before durable intent prevents any dispatch
endpoint drift immediately before dispatch leaves durable intent and never resends
concurrent invocations cannot dispatch a second deletion
early failure with only one proven principal never invents another Auth target
exact H166 revision advances survive reopen; metadata, rewind and excess advance remain protected
an intent without explicit404 cannot justify seven revision increments
already absent without an attempt cannot attribute a new revision delta to this adapter
separate factories sharing one durable journal still dispatch at most once
preflight expiration after durable persistence blocks dispatch and leaves reconciliation only
zero POS targets still require committed and verified SQL result with exact empty manifest

limitations: This does not certify a remote SQL commit or GoTrue deletion.
The caller must validate and durably preserve original commit, postcheck and identity artifacts.
Fresh SELECT and GoTrue DELETE are separate transactions; concurrent changes can require review.
